artwork_title: A FINE CARVED BAMBOO 'PINE' LIBATION CUP
description_block: 17th/18th century Naturalistically carved and well-hollowed as a pine tree trunk, the exterior finely carved in high relief with gnarled pine branches bearing clusters of pine needles encircling the vessel, the bark showing natural knotting and undulating, scaly bark, the bamboo patinated to a warm creamy brown tone. 14cm (5 1/2in) diam.

artwork_title: Rocky Landscape Brushpot
description_block: 17th/18th century Of irregular conical form, flaring slightly, carved in high relief with a watery landscape complete with jutting rocks gnarled pines, bamboo and remote pavilions, the wood smoothly patinated to a variegated warm reddish-brown colour, traces of black lacquer to the surface. 12.5cm (4 7/8in) high.

artwork_title: A RARE CARVED BAMBOO 'LOTUS AND ROCKWORK' LIBATION CUP
description_block: 17th/18th century Raised on a series of short feet carved to extend to a series of irregular protruding rocks from which emerges a conical-form lotus leaf, carved with Y-shaped veins to the exterior, the rim subtly carved to depict the edge of the leaf, tightly curled in places, the interior narrowing to a cylinder towards the base. 12cm (4 3/4in) high.

artwork_title: Kangxi
description_block: Kangxi Each standing in flowing robes tied with a sash, one with its hair fashionably tied back and holding a tray supporting cups, the other, with its hair in a pair of buns, holding a wine ewer, both dressed in long, flowing robes folded in layers, their faces smiling, the bamboo with an attractive warm patina, wood stands. 26cm (10 1/4in) high. (4).

artwork_title: A LARGE BAMBOO 'SHOULAO AND BOYS' GROUP
description_block: 17th/18th century Crisply carved with Shoulao, the God of Longevity, grasping a sprig of lingzhi fungus in his left hand, and reclining against a rocky outcrop, whilst a group of seven boys variously present him with gifts, reach to catch a low flying bat or playfully tickle his foot, the wood of warm amber tone. 23.5cm (9 1/4in) high.

artwork_title: Korea, Birds in a lotus ponds
description_block: Korea, Birds in a lotus ponds, 18th/19th century Ink and colour on silk, mounted as two four-panel folding screens. Each painting 170cm (66 7/8in) high × 61cm (24in) wide. (2).

artwork_title: A Carved Bamboo 'Plum Blossom' Scoop or Ink-Palette, Bitian
description_block: 17th century Naturalistically carved in the form of a large gently curving well-veined leaf, borne on a snort branch with attendent prunus buds and blossoms carved and pierced in high relief shadowing a small spider nestled on the leaf's surface, the wood of rich brown hue. 9.6cm (3 3/4in) long.

artwork_title: 18th century
description_block: 18th century Of baluster form, well turned and hollowed, rising from an intricately stepped foot to rounded shoulders and an everted rim, superbly carved in relief with the Eight Trigrams, bagua , equally spaced below the shoulders. 10.8cm (4 1/4in) high.

artwork_title: A Carved Cinnabar Lacquer Double-Sided Table Screen
description_block: 17th century The rectangular panel carved on one side with a figurative scene of scholars playing weiqi with boy attendants and a crane flying overhead, the reverse carved with a calligraphy inscription, raised on a cinnabar lacquer base carved with diaper patterns. 23.5cm (9 1/4in) high. (2).

artwork_title: A RARE CARVED BAMBOO 'WANG XIZHI' BRUSHPOT, BITONG
description_block: 18th century The cylindrical brushpot raised on three short feet, deeply carved with the great calligrapher sitting beneath a pine tree, with a disciple sitting before him and two attendants, one bearing a washer and another a goose, behind the tree a low table bearing a set of books and other scholarly paraphernalia. 14.8cm (5 7/8in) high.

artwork_title: Ode to the Red Cliffs
description_block: Dated by inscription to the Jiachen year, corresponding to 1724 or 1784 and of the period Finely carved with a continuous scene depicting Su Shi and his companions travelling on the Yangtze River, the boat passing by pine and overhanging rocks amongst swirling waters, bearing an inscription, the vessel of pale brown hue. 12.2cm (4 13/16in) high.

artwork_title: A LARGE ROOTWOOD 'SAGE' SCHOLAR'S ROCK
description_block: Qing Dynasty The naturalistic wood carved with knots and gnarled outcrops, resembling a solitary figure seating beneath an arched overhanging rock with jagged edges, fitted stand. 66cm (26in) high. (2).

artwork_title: A LARGE KESI 'MAGU' PANEL
description_block: Late 19th century Woven and painted with the goddess in trailing robes carrying a tray with a lingzhi -shaped sceptre and two cups, beside a boy attendant and a phoenix, mounted as a hanging scroll. 153cm (60 1/4in) high x 79cm (31 1/8in) wide.

artwork_title: A Baitong and Huangtong-Inlaid Lacquer Document Box and Cover
description_block: 17th century Of rectangular form, the cover top inset with baitong elements to depict a landscape scene of travellers on horseback traversing a rock-filled landscape beneath a pine tree and a pavilion against a black lacquer ground, the edges banded in huangtong with inset scenes to the sides of the cover and base with a pair of pheasants among peony flowers and foliage, the base and interior lacquered black. 11.3cm (4 1/2in) high x 46cm (18 1/8in) wide x 23cm (9in) deep.

artwork_title: A LARGE SOAPSTONE CARVING OF GUANYIN
description_block: 18th century The goddess sitting with the hands drawn under long flowing robes over a raised left knee, the head lowered in meditative contemplation, the hair swept up in a high chignon with the robe and hood hung over the top, finely incised with gilt-filled patterns of clouds and lotus flowers. 26.5cm (10 1/4in) high.

artwork_title: A SOAPSTONE CARVING OF SHOULAO RIDING A LUDUAN
description_block: 18th century The sage in flowing robes tied with a cord over his corpulent frame, a jovial expression on the face, a ruyi sceptre held in his right hand, his left hand resting on the single-horned deer-like mythical beast, on which he perches, the animal's legs tucked beneath and head slightly raised, the stone of an creamy amber tone, all supported on a separate low rockwork base with red suffusions to the stone. 22.5cm (8 7/8in) high. (2).

artwork_title: TWO CARVED CINNABAR LACQUER CIRCULAR BOXES AND COVERS
description_block: 16th/17th century The first of circular form, the top deeply carved with a boy holding a lotus sprig raised above his head which is turned to view a butterfly in flight, the straight sides with key-fret borders; the second, of circular form with a domed cover carved with a luohan sitting on a mat beneath a pine tree in a rocky landscape beside an incense burner, the deeply rounded sides carved with three pine trees amidst rocks, the base and interiors of each box lacquered black. 6.3cm (2 1/2in) and 7.5cm (3in) diam. (4).

artwork_title: TWO RARE CARVED ZITAN 'TIXI' INCENSE BOXES AND COVERS
description_block: 18th century One of domed circular form carved in simulation of guri lacquer with three ruyi heads arranged in a circle to the cover and base; the other carved with a pattern of four ruyi heads encircling a four-petal flowerhead, repeated on the cover and base, box. The largest 7.7cm (3in) diam. (5).

artwork_title: THREE CARVED ZITAN VESSELS
description_block: 18th century Comprising a tool vase of irregular cylindrical form carved as a gnarled and knotted tree trunk with a narrow cylindrical hole set into the flat top; an elegant cylindrical tool vase with waisted neck of banchuiping form; and a well hollowed cup with a ribbed rim flanked by a pair of trapezoid handles. The largest: 13.8cm (5 3/8in) high. (3).

artwork_title: A Famille Rose Sgraffiato Lime-Green-Ground Lantern Vase
description_block: Qianlong seal mark, late Qing Dynasty/Republic Period Of ovoid form, with a waisted neck and everted rim, finely enamelled with two large rectangular panels enclosing figures in an expansive watery landscape, against a lime-green sgraffiato ground interspersed with floral sprays, the interior of the rim and base turquoise, with iron-red seal mark. 44.3cm (17 1/2in) high.

artwork_title: A RARE SMALL YIXING STONEWARE VASE, FANGHU
description_block: Signed Xiang Shensi, cyclically dated to the spring of the Guiwei year, corresponding to 1643 or 1703 and of the period Of archaistic form, with two delicately applied tubular handles just below a leiwan border at the rim, above a raised band of plaited twine, the body carved to one side with a fifteen-character inscription, the stoneware of a rich reddish-brown colour. 6cm (2 3/8in) high.

artwork_title: A YIXING STONEWARE GARLIC-NECK 'CHILONG AND NUTS' VASE
description_block: Late Qing Dynasty/Republic Period Of bottle form, after the Han dynasty bronze prototype, the cylindrical neck spreading to form five bulbils at the rim, the body applied, in five tones of clay with a chi dragon clambering around the neck, and a ring around the shoulder of eight equally placed and highly naturalistic beans, nuts and fruit. 26.5cm (10 3/8in) high.

artwork_title: A LARGE HUANGHUALI DOCUMENT BOX AND COVER
description_block: 18th century Of rectangular form, the interior with long hinge mounts, the two short sides with metal bracket handles attached to scallop-edged mounts, the fittings attached to the cover by circular bosses plush with the surface of the wood, the well-figured wood of light brown tone, the base plate made of jichimu , key. 54cm (21 1/4in) wide x 39cm (15 3/8in) deep x 15.6cm (6 1/8in) high. (2).

artwork_title: A Huanghuali Wood Medicine Chest and Cover, Yaoxiang
description_block: 18th century Of rectangular form with a hump-back handle at the top, reinforced with ruyi -head plates at the edges, the interior separated into drawers of various sizes, all enclosed within a sideways cover fasten with a lock at the top. 37cm (14 5/8in) wide x 25cm (9 7/8in) deep x 34cm (13 3/8in) high. (2).

artwork_title: A RARE LARGE CARVED ZITAN CEREMONIAL STAND
description_block: 18th century Of octagonal-section, with tapering faceted sides, rounded shoulders and a waisted neck with a thickly lipped rim, set with veneered panels to form a wide band of flower heads borne on foliage with banana lappets running up from the base and outwards either  side of the base of the shoulders from a key-fret band, all below a further key-fret band, the interior aperture of cylindrical form. 34.5cm (13 5/8in) high.

artwork_title: Manwoldaegyehoedo (Picture of a Gathering at Manwoldae)
description_block: Manwoldaegyehoedo (Picture of a Gathering at Manwoldae) Ink and colour on paper, glazed and framed. 67cm (26 3/8in) high × 31.5cm (12 3/8in) wide.

artwork_title: A SMALL BAMBOO CARVING OF SHAKYAMUNI BUDDHA AS AN ASCETIC
description_block: 18th/19th century The ascetic figure with a tonsured head and serene and meditative expression, seated with his right leg raised crossing over his left leg, his hands resting on the knee of his raised left leg, loosely dressed in a simple dhoti , revealing his bare emaciated body with ribs and knobbly spine, seated on a bed of leaves. 9.5cm (3 3/4in) high.

artwork_title: Fisherman and Woodcutter Brushpot
description_block: 18th century Of cylindrical form, incised around the exterior with a farmer looking out across a river at a fisherman sitting on a boat resting beneath the shade of pine branches growing from an overhanging rocky bank, inscribed to one side in semi-cursive script, mounted onto a wood base with tripod feet. 11cm (4 3/8in) high.

artwork_title: Boys at Play
description_block: Signed Qian Daxin (1728-1804), Qianlong/Jiaqing Of curved rectangular form, the surface finely carved in low relief with a scene of three boys playing a board game within a garden setting, surrounded by bamboo, rockworks, and tree trunk, carved to the upper right corner with a inscription in semi-cursive script, followed by a two-character mark reading zhu ting . 14.7cm (5 3/4in) long.

artwork_title: A RARE CARVED BAMBOO 'HORSES AND OFFICIAL' BRUSHPOT, BITONG
description_block: 18th century The cylindrical vessel supported on three shallow feet and rising to a channelled rim, carved in relief with a an official or scholar leading a horse with two further horses behind. 14.3cm (5 5/8in) high.

artwork_title: A LARGE CARVED BAMBOO OPENWORK RUYI SCEPTRE
description_block: 19th century The bow-shaped stem expertly carved and pierced with entwined branches of flowering prunus, bamboo and lingzhi -fungus, the head carved as a branch bearing three peaches, a lingzhi fungus and a stylised finger citron. 42cm (16 1/2in) long.

artwork_title: Qing Dynasty
description_block: Qing Dynasty The circular cover with straight sides and sloping shoulders rising to a flat panel carved in relief with lakeside mountains and various trees, some leaves of inlaid green-stained wood, a sampan in the foreground beside a house, the sloping shoulders with classic foliate scroll and further inlay, the straight sides of the box and cover with diaper-pattern, the box with upright lappets above a band of key-fret on the foot. 20.5cm (8 1/8in) diam. (2).

artwork_title: A Carved Bamboo 'Mountain' Brushrest
description_block: 17th/18th century Deeply and intricately carved in the round with a tall irregularly shaped rock overhanging a gushing stream with a bridge, two sages sitting at a table playing weiqi (go) with two attendants sheltering beneath a gnarled pine tree, the scene surrounded by various smaller rocky outcrops. 10.8cm (4 1/4in) long.

artwork_title: A LARGE CHENXIANGMU 'EIGHT IMMORTALS' RUYI SCEPTRE
description_block: Qing Dynasty The large sceptre terminating with a large head, meticulously carved in relief with Shoulao flanked by the two Daoist Immortals Cao Guojiu and Zhang Guolao among rocks and pine branches, the arching shaft with an upturned terminus, similarly carved with the remaining six Immortals and the four characters ji , xiang , ru , and yi ('good fortune and everything as you wish'), equally spaced and carved in its own rectangular cartouche, all against a background of rocks and pine branches extending around the sceptre. 56cm (22in) long.

artwork_title: A VERY RARE IMPERIAL YELLOW-GROUND TWELVE-SYMBOL 'DRAGON' ROBE, JIFU
material: yellow silk, gold and silver-wrapped threads
description_block: Early 19th century The yellow silk ground robe superbly embroidered with varying tones of gold and silver-wrapped threads with nine Imperial five-clawed dragons clutching or courting flaming pearls of wisdom amidst ruyi -clouds above rolling waves on the lishui , the Twelve Symbols of Imperial Authority scattered throughout, the sleeves and cuffs decorated en suite , with original brocade edgings, lined with yellow silk damask. 225cm (88 5/8in) wide x 155.5cm (61 1/4in) long.

artwork_title: A Rare Imperial Midnight-Blue-Ground 'Dragon Roundel' Embroidered Robe, Jifu
description_block: Circa 1870 Meticulously worked on the front and back in satin stitch and couched gold threads with eight roundels each enclosing a writhing, five-clawed dragon clutching or pursuing the flaming pearl amidst dense trailing scrolls of ruyi clouds interspersed with bats and the Eight Auspicious Emblems, all above the Terrestrial Diagram and lishui stripe at the hem, picked out in vibrant shades of blue, purple, yellow, red, coral and green, the matching dark-blue-ground collar and cuffs worked with further dragons amidst bats, clouds and waves, lined in blue silk. 136.5cm (53 3/4in) long x 190cm (74 3/4in) wide.

artwork_title: A LARGE EMBROIDERED SILK 'HUNDRED BIRDS' PANEL
description_block: 19th century Finely embroidered with a wide range of colourful birds flying over and swimming in a lotus pond filled with flowers and interspersed with butterflies, all on a cream silk ground, framed. 195cm (76 3/4in) wide x 44.3cm (17 1/2in) high.

artwork_title: AN EMBROIDERED DOUBLE-SIDED YELLOW SILK 'DRAGON' BANNER
description_block: Late Qing Dynasty, 1861-1888 Comprising a large triangular panel sown in silk thread on each side with a large sinuous five-clawed dragon with streaming tail feathers, embroidered in shades of blue, in pursuit of a red pearl, the dragon rendered in gold thread, all against a yellow ground. 228cm (89 3/4in) long.

artwork_title: A VERY RARE BLUE AND WHITE AND IRON-RED 'PHOENIX' MOONFLASK, BAOYUEPING
description_block: Qianlong seal mark and of the period Of flattened globular form, supported on an oval spreading foot, rising to a short waisted neck, the body exquisitely painted in iron-red with a pair of phoenixes swooping to face each other below a flaming pearl, their finely detailed tail feathers fanned out naturalistically behind and legs swept back, among a network of meandering foliage in deep tones of blue encasing the entire body and bearing peony and lotus flowerheads symmetrically laid out in iron-red, a pair of fearsome elephantine masks handles emerging from the neck, the bifurcated trunks resting on the shoulders, the neck with a band of ruyi heads below a later metal mount incised to the inner rim with a floral pattern. 24.1cm (9 1/2in) high.

artwork_title: Portrait of Prince Guogong
description_block: Portrait of Prince Guogong (1733-1765), sixth son of the Yongzheng Emperor Oil on Korean paper, with beaded gilt-wood frame and glazed. 52cm (19 1/4in) wide x 68.5cm (25in) high.

artwork_title: European Lady with Pomogranate; European Lady with Child and Butterfly; European Lady with Basket
description_block: European Lady with Pomogranate; European Lady with Child and Butterfly; European Lady with Basket, 18th/19th century Three works, ink and colour on silk, glazed and framed. Each 145cm (57 1/8in) high x 51cm (20 1/8in) wide. (3).

artwork_title: A Boxed Imperial Album of Sixteen Rubbings and Woodblock Prints from the Imperially Inscribed Illustrations of Cotton Cultivation and Manufacture, Yuzhi Mianhua Tu
description_block: Qianlong, circa 1770s Comprising sixteen double pages each with a woodblock print opposite a rubbing compiled by Fang Guancheng (1698-1768), zitan boards, pink silk liner, presented in a box, the zitan top delicately carved with bamboo and millet with a four character title inscribed Qianlong yuzhi . The album 28cm (11in) high x 28cm (11in) wide. (2).

artwork_title: Republic Period
description_block: Republic Period Ink and colour on silk, signed, mounted alongside a titleslip signed Chen Shutong (1876-1966) and dated Yichou year in accordance to 1925, as a hanging scroll. 90.5cm (35 5/8in) high x 49.6cm (19 5/8in) wide.

artwork_title: Qing Dynasty
material: ink, colour and gilt on silk
description_block: Qing Dynasty With inscription identifying the portrait as Prince Yi, inscribed and with seal Liu Zonghan; ink, colour and gilt on silk, hanging scroll with hongmu scroll ends. 153cm (60 1/4in) high x 96cm (37 3/4in) wide.

artwork_title: Shoulao
description_block: Shoulao, 1735 Ink and colour on paper, hanging scroll. 110.5cm (43 1/2in) high × 55.6cm (21 7/8in) wide.

artwork_title: A large family portrait
description_block: A large family portrait, Late Qing Dynasty Ink and colour on paper. 266cm (104 3/4in) wide x 133cm (52 3/8in) high.

artwork_title: A THANKGA OF AMITABHA BUDDHA IN HIS PURE LAND
description_block: Tibet, 19th century Distemper on cloth, the reverse with Tibetan 'om, ah, hum' invocations behind each figure, cloth mount. 66.5cm (26 3/16in) high × 44cm (17 5/16in) wide.

artwork_title: Tibet
description_block: Tibet, 19th century Distemper on cloth, the reverse with Tibetan inscriptions on a line drawing of a stupa, comprising consecration mantras, the 'ye dharma hetu' Buddhist creed, and the 'Patience Prayer', also inscribed with 'om, ah, hum' incantations behind various figures, with silk brocaded mount. 66cm (26in) high × 50cm (19 5/8in) wide.

artwork_title: N/A
material: Distemper on cloth, silk brocaded mount
description_block: Tibet, 19th century Distemper on cloth, the reverse with inscribed Tibetan 'om, ah, hum' incantations behind each figure, with silk brocaded mount. 65.5cm (25 7/8in) high x 44.5cm (17 1/2in) wide.

artwork_title: A THANKGA OF GREEN TARA
material: Distemper on cloth, silk brocaded mount
description_block: Tibet, 19th century Distemper on cloth, the reverse with Tibetan 'om, ah, hum' invocations in red ink behind each figure, with original silk brocaded mount. 63cm (24 7/8in) high × 46cm (18 1/8in) wide.

artwork_title: A Thangka of Padmasambhava in His Pure Land
material: Distemper on cloth, silk brocaded mount
description_block: Tibet, 19th century Distemper on cloth, the reverse with Tibetan inscriptions comprising 'om, ah, hum' incantations, consecration mantras, the 'ye dharma hetu' Buddhist creed, and a dedicatory prayer in cursive script, with silk brocaded mount. 94cm (37in) high × 65cm (25 5/8in) wide.

artwork_title: Tibet, 19th century
description_block: Tibet, 19th century Distemper on cloth, the reverse with a hand impression and Tibetan 'om, ah, hum' invocations behind each figure, with cloth mount. 65cm (25 5/8in) high × 43cm (16 7/8in) wide.

artwork_title: N/A
description_block: Tibet, 18th century Distemper on cloth, the reverse with Tibetan inscriptions on a line drawing of a stupa, comprising consecration mantras, the 'ye dharma hetu' Buddhist creed, and the 'Patience Prayer', also inscribed with 'om, ah, hum' incantations behind various figures, with silk brocaded mount. 66.5cm (26 1/8in) high × 50cm (19 5/8in) wide.

artist_name: A THANKGA OF BAKULA AND RAHULA
artwork_title: A THANKGA OF BAKULA AND RAHULA
description_block: Tibet, 18th century Distemper on cloth, the reverse with Tibetan 'om, ah, hum' invocations in red pigment behind each figure, with cloth mount. 71cm (28in) high × 46cm (18 1/8in) wide.

artwork_title: A LARGE THANGKA OF AVALOKITESHVARA WITH GAUTAMA BUDDHA AND GREEN TARA
description_block: 19th century Each deity on lotus bases over stepped thrones with elaborate architectural toranas , backed by identical blue-and-gold aureoles with translucent auras, Eleven-Headed Avalokiteshvara at the centre, Gutama Buddha on the left sitting in dhyanasana and holding the blue medicine bowl and Green Tara on the right, surrounded by various other deities. 130.5cm (51 3/8in) wide x 75cm (29 1/2in high) high.

artwork_title: NINE DRAGONS BOWL CASE AND COVER
description_block: Tibet, circa 15th century Finely cast in openwork, the hinged cover cast with a central roundel enclosing a coiled dragon among foliage, within a wide border of three further coiled dragons, the sides similarly decorated with four dragons, and a single large dragon to the base, containing a wooden alms bowl, and cloth liner. 18.3cm (7 1/4in) diam. (3).

artwork_title: A Pair of Silver and Gold Damascened Iron Stirrup
description_block: Tibet, circa 15th/17th century The rectangular pierced footrest with upright sides with round edged sides each enclosing a panel of the flaming pearl, below the looping handle, set with separately cast mounts cast with a crouching dragon, with a lion mask below the strap loop. 14.6cm (5 3/4in) high. (2).

artwork_title: Tibet, Derge, 15th century
description_block: Tibet, Derge, 15th century The flat circular base with a border of flower heads worked in fine relief richly damascened in gold, the high arching sides worked with makara and foliate scrollwork below a the broad top section with flanges flanking a central panel enclosing a snow lion, all surmounted by a strap loop for suspension. 18.4cm (7 1/4in) high.

artwork_title: Qianlong four-character mark and of the period
description_block: Qianlong four-character mark and of the period The spreading domed body of the bell cast with a concentric band of vajra set between a beaded border below a band of dharmachakra and vajra , the shoulder carved in relief with a band of petal lappets, each enclosing a lança character, the reign mark incised around the neck above the shoulder, the gilt handle modelled with a half four-pronged vajra finial surmounting the face of Buddha below, the interior cast with an inscription in lança script. 22.8cm (9in) high.

artwork_title: A GOLD-AND-SILVER-DAMASCENED IRON DECORATED SADDLE, GSER SGA
material: gold damascened iron, silver damascened ground, bronze, silk brocade
description_block: Tibet, circa 15th/17th century The front pommel, skirts and back cantle decorated with gold damascened iron fittings decorated with Buddhist lions flanking flaming pearls among dragons and scrolling lotus flowers against a pierced silver damascened ground, all within beaded bronze borders, a yellow silk brocade sash fitted with four domed pommels. 56cm (22in) long x 31.5cm (12 3/8in) wide x 24.5cm (9 5/8in) high.

artist_name: A GOLD-AND-SILVER-DAMASCENED IRON DECORATED SADDLE, GSER SGA
artwork_title: Tibet, circa 15th/17th century
description_block: Tibet, circa 15th/17th century The front pommel, skirts and back cantle decorated with gilt iron damascened fittings decorated with coiled dragons flanking Garuda with further pairs of tigers and cranes against a ground of finely worked and pierced silver damascened leafy foliage. 52.5cm (20 5/8in) long x 34cm (13 3/8in) wide x 22cm (8 5/8in) high.

artwork_title: Tang Dynasty
description_block: Tang Dynasty Finely modelled with a muscular frame, the head turned slightly to the right, the ears pricked and the mouth open, with a hogged mane and docked tail, the separately made saddle covered with a knotted cloth, traces of red pigment. 78.3cm (30 7/8in) high x 71.5cm (28 1/8in) long x 20cm (7 7/8in) wide. (2).

artwork_title: A RARE AND LARGE DOCUMENTARY BRONZE FIGURE OF A LUOHAN
description_block: Ming Dynasty, dated to the 17th year of Chenghua, corresponding to 1481 and of the period Cast seated in dhyanasana and clad in a long flowing robe extending over his head with bulging eyes in intense contemplation and falling in diaphanous cascades, leaving the chest exposed, fastened ribbon beneath, his feet tucked beneath the pleats of his robe and a pair of shoes resting on the platform below, the right side with a cast inscription, wood stand with a double lotus base, the back carved with reticulated flames. 67.6cm (26 5/8in) high (without stand). (2).

artwork_title: A Carved Limestone Head of Buddha
description_block: Northern Qi Dynasty Exquisitely carved with benevolent expression, the hooded almond-shaped eyes beneath elegantly arching brows converging down to the straight nose above sensuous rose-bud lips, all between ears with long pendulous lobes and surmounted by tightly curled hair and domed ushnisha , stand. 23cm (9in) high. (2).

artwork_title: A Carved Stone Head of a Bodhisattva
description_block: Liao Dynasty Finely carved with naturally rendered features, the rounded oval face with a serene expression, with arched brows above downcast eyes and well-defined full lips and pendulous earlobes set with flower head adornments, the neatly combed hair drawn up behind an elaborate floral diadem with a seated Amitabha at its centre, stand. 39cm (15 3/8in) high. (2).

artwork_title: A LARGE GILT-COPPER REPOUSSÉ HEAD OF A LAMA
description_block: Tibet, 17th century Naturalistically worked in repoussé with almond-shaped eyes beneath arched eyebrows, the rose-bud lips shaped into a gentle smile, the benevolent face flanked by long ears gilt below neatly cropped hair, the eyes and mouths highlighted with black and red pigment, stand. 36cm (14 1/8in) high. (2).

artwork_title: Jin Dynasty
description_block: Jin Dynasty Finely modelled as a recumbent tiger, with alert animated expression, the head resting on the front paws, the mouth partly open to reveal two protruding fangs, fluidly painted in brown and tan glazes on a cream ground with bold striped markings, the flat bean shaped upper panel decorated with a bird perched on a bamboo spray, turned to look at an insect, the base unglazed. 33cm (13in) long.

artwork_title: A RARE JUNYAO LIGHT-BLUE-GLAZED BOWL
description_block: Northern Song/early Jin Dynasty Finely potted with deep rounded sides rising from a short straight foot to a gently everted rim, covered in a light blue glaze suffused with a faint craquelure falling slightly unevenly above the foot rim, box. 11.5cm (4 1/2in) diam. (2).

artwork_title: Ming Dynasty
description_block: Ming Dynasty Well-hollowed of curving conical form, carved in the form of a mythical beast with the head forming the base and the neck widening towards the rim which spreads to form a spout, the beast with large bulging eyes beneath bushy eyebrows and rays of curls, a dragon head emerging from the rim opposite the spout, from which emerges a phoenix which forms a handle attaching at the body below the bird's head, archaistic patterns decorated around the body, the stone of creamy pale-green tone with russet to milky white inclusions, wood stand. 14.8cm (5 7/8in) high. (2).

artwork_title: Buddhist Lion Scroll Weight
description_block: 17th century Of low squat form, deftly-carved with the head raised slightly turned to the right, with wispy eyebrows and neatly quaffed curls between the ears and to the tail, incised with flames along the back, the stone of a pale green hue with a rich chestnut skin along the upper side, wood stand. 13cm (5 1/8in) long. (2).

artwork_title: A FINE JADEITE 'CHILONG' BELT HOOK
description_block: 19th century The terminal finely carved in with a twin-horned dragon head, with large bulging eyes, turning to face a smaller sinuous chilong clasping a sprig of lingzhi over the arched shaft, the underside with a circular boss, the stone of an apple-green translucent hue. 9.5cm (3 3/4in) long.

artwork_title: A WHITE JADE 'RAMS' CARVING
description_block: 18th/19th century Carved as a ram with its head turned back and legs tucked beneath, with a lamb nestled alongside, each with a spray of lingzhi grasped in the mouth with a yinyang pearl nestled on the fungus, the stone of even white tone with a subtle tinge of pale green, wood stand. 5cm (2in) long. (2).

artwork_title: A SUPERB WHITE AND CHESTNUT-BROWN AGATE CATFISH SCROLL WEIGHT
description_block: 18th century The flattened body deftly carved in the round with the head turned rightward and the tail looping to the left, and barbels trailing out below, the waxy stone of satin-white, with streaks of rich chestnut-brown. 13cm (5 1/8in) long.

artwork_title: A RARE MUGHAL OLIVE GREEN JADE 'FLORAL' VASE AND OPENWORK STRAINER
description_block: 18th century The globular body supported on a splayed foot with a cylindrical neck widening very slightly to an everted rim, delicately incised around the body and neck with geometrically arranged floral sprays, the inverted interior of the foot carved with a flowerhead with five bands of petals, the interior of the rim set with a separate pale green jade pierced floral roundel set at the level of the shoulders, the stone of translucent olive green. 11.8 cm (4 5/8in) high.

artwork_title: A RARE VERY PALE GREEN JADE 'CHILONG' BOTTLE VASE
description_block: 18th century With ovoid globular body surmounted by a tall cylindrical neck, carved in high relief with a coiled chi dragon wrapped around it with its head raised above the rim, raised on spreading foot, the stone of very pale green tone with white streaks. 16cm (6 5/16in) high.

artwork_title: Guangxu
description_block: Guangxu Boldly carved, the thick square body crowned by a majestic pair of addorsed five-clawed dragons, seated upon their haunches with bulging eyes and open jaws, their scaly, ribbed bodies curling with a sense of latent energy, the square base precisely carved in intaglio script ( yinwen ) with the five characters Tihe dian yulan ('Imperially Reviewed at the Tihe Hall'), the translucent stone of apple-green tone, suffused with russet and inky black tones. 12.9cm (5 1/16in) square.

artwork_title: Qianlong/Jiaqing
description_block: Qianlong/Jiaqing Carved from a single large piece of stone, the wide curved sides below an everted rim rising from four short feet, incised with floral patterns, the interior well-hollowed between two large dragon head masks, each emerging from the rim with bulbous eyes and thick trailing eyebrows, above a loop handle suspending a freely moving ring, the stone of pale whitish-green tone. 27.3cm (10 3/4in) long across the handles.

artwork_title: Qianlong/Jiaqing
description_block: Qianlong/Jiaqing Of rectangular form, each side deeply carved in varying levels of relief bordered by key-fret and wan scroll, one side with two ladies, each steering a boat laden with a flower basket, one also attended by a boy servant and jar, all amidst a mountainous scape laden with pine, fruit-bearing peach and other trees below outcrops and cloud-scrolls, the reverse similarly carved with a mountainous landscape with pine, fir, wutong and other trees, the stone of lustrous even pale green tone, hongmu wood stand inset with a 'dream stone' panel decorated with three mountain peaks. 25.8cm (10 1/8in) high × 18.5cm (7 1/4in) wide. (2).

artwork_title: A RARE PALE GREEN AND RUSSET JADE 'DRAGON AND PHOENIX' PENDANT
description_block: Warring States Period Crisply carved on each side as a dragon with long crescent shaped body, tapering to a sharp point, with bevelled spiral ridges, its head facing forwards, with the forearm grasping over its back to hold a phoenix, whose head faces backwards above curving plumage and tail feathers, the stone of yellowish-green tone with brown inclusions, stand and box. 11.9cm (4 5/8in) long. (3).

artwork_title: AN ARCHAISTIC PALE GREEN AND RUSSET JADE POURING VESSEL, YI
description_block: Southern Song/Ming Dynasty The vessel with a rounded body of oval section, supported on four archaistic taotie -mask feet, extending at one end for pouring, the opposite end set with a scrolling loop-handle carved with a further taotie -mask at the top, the exterior with a band of incised archaistic kui dragons interspersed with flowerheads, the pale green stone with brownish-russet inclusions, box. 15cm (6in) long. (2).

artwork_title: Peach and Bat Box and Cover
description_block: Qianlong/Jiaqing The box expertly carved and pierced as a large peach issuing from a gnarled and leafy branches with further smaller peaches, the interior with a bat, the cover similarly carved with branches and leaves with finely incised veins, the stone of even green tone, hongmu stand. 15.5cm (6 1/8in) wide. (3).

artwork_title: Qianlong
description_block: Qianlong Exquisitely carved as an elegant baluster vase flanked by a pair of scroll-handles on the neck, the stepped cover surmounted by a Buddhist-lion finial, all beside a phoenix with finely incised feathers clasping a sprig of peaches in its beak and standing on a large gnarled branch issuing plum blossoms, magnolia, and auspicious lingzhi fungus curling around a small quatrefoil waterpot, the stone of dark green tone with black speckles, carved wood stand, box. 22cm (8 1/2in) long. (4).

artwork_title: A YELLOW JADE PLAQUE AND A WHITE JADE PLAQUE
description_block: Qing Dynasty/Republic Period, the white jade plaque signed Zigang The yellow jade plaque incised on one side with a scene depicting two boys beside a waterway, the reverse with a large spray of lingzhi fungus beneath a bat, the stone of a yellow-green colour with russet inclusion; the white jade plaque with the Hehe Erxian beside a bat and a bird, the reverse with a poetic inscription, the stone of an even white colour. The yellow jade plaque: 6cm (2 3/8in) long; the white jade plaque: 5.4cm (2 1/8in) long. (2).

artwork_title: A PALE GREEN JADE 'LOTUS' LIBATION CUP
description_block: 18th century Crisply carved and hollowed as an undulating lotus leaf with finely incised veins, issuing from long curling stems forming the base and issuing further smaller leaves and a large blossoming lotus flower with fleshy petals, a conch shell on the side, the stone of whitish pale green tone. 9.5cm (3 3/4in) high.

artwork_title: A PALE GREEN JADE RUYI SCEPTRE
description_block: 19th century Crisply carved with a long shaft carved in high relief with scrolling lotus flowers borne on leafy stems trailing up the handle and terminating with a large lingzhi -fungus shaped head incised with a deer beneath bat and peaches, the stone of pale green tone with grey inclusions, wood stand. 47.5cm (18 3/4in) long. (2).

artwork_title: A LARGE CLOISONNÉ ENAMEL 'LOTUS' VASE, HU
description_block: 17th century The pear-shaped body supported on a splayed foot and rising to a waisted neck with flared rim, the shoulders set with a pair of bronze lion-mask handles suspending loose rings, the exterior brightly enamelled on a turquoise ground with sections enclosing large lotus blooms wreathed in scrolling foliage issuing curling leaves, the four main horizontal bands divided by three thinner bands of floral scrolls on a darker blue ground, the spreading foot similarly decorated with a band of lotus blooms. 52.5cm (20 3/4in) high.

artwork_title: A LARGE GILT BRONZE AND CLOISONNÉ ENAMEL VASE, FANGGU
description_block: Jingtai four-character mark, Kangxi Of square section and tall archaistic form, the neck and flaring foot decorated respectively with an upright and pendant lappet band enclosing a kui -dragon among ruyi -head clouds, the neck with a further panel enclosing a dragon above the mid-section, decorated with taotie -mask patterns, all against a turquoise ground, each face set to the centre and edge with flanges decorated on either side with a thin band of floral sprays, the interior of the rim with a wide band of scrolling lotus flowers. 52.5cm (20 3/4in) high.

artwork_title: Jingtai four-character mark, Qianlong
description_block: Jingtai four-character mark, Qianlong Of drum-shaped form, raised on three cabriole feet shaped as scrolling clouds, flanked by a pair of long stepped loop-handles decorated with cross designs and stylised shou characters, with bands of gilt bronze bosses at the rim and above the feet, the body colourfully decorated with a continuous scene of birds in a luscious garden, with a pond filled with lotus flowers, pine trees, flowering magnolia and prunus, fruiting pomegranates, lingzhi fungus, tree peonies and daisies, and pairs of birds of paradise, magpies, cranes and a single egret all delicately worked and coloured against a turquoise ground sky, the recessed base with the mark cast within a square cartouche. 35cm (13 3/4in) across the handles x 24.5cm (9 3/4in) high.

artwork_title: Qianlong four-character mark and of the period
description_block: Qianlong four-character mark and of the period Of sampan form, decorated in blue, yellow, green, pink and red enamels with classic lotus scrolls amidst archaistic stylised kui dragons, all against a turquoise blue ground, the base white with red double square containing the reign mark. 16.3cm (6 1/2in) long.

artwork_title: AN IMPERIAL-TRIBUTE PAINTED ENAMEL RUBY-GROUND 'PEONY' BOWL
description_block: Qianlong seal mark and of the period The deep rounded sides supported on a short foot rising to a slightly flared rim, the exterior finely decorated in shades of green, yellow and purple with four peonies and further buds borne on leafy sprays set against the ruby-ground, the interior pale turquoise. 15.3cm (6in) diam.

artwork_title: A RARE BLUE-GLAZED SAUCER-DISH
description_block: Qianlong seal mark and of the period Finely potted with curving sides rising from a short slightly inward-tapering foot, the interior and exterior covered in a lustrous blue glaze thinning to white on the mouth rim, the base glazed white, box. 16cm (6 1/4in) diam. (2).

artwork_title: A RARE DOUCAI 'FIVE TREASURES' CUP
description_block: Chenghua six-character mark, 18th century Finely potted with deeply rounded sides, decorated around the exterior with five lotus sprays, each supporting a bowl containing an auspicious emblem, the base painted with a six-character mark in underglaze blue. 6.7cm (2 5/8in) diam.

artwork_title: Kangxi
description_block: Kangxi Elegantly potted with deep curving sides rising from a short, slightly inward-tapering foot, to a slightly everted rim, the interior with a phoenix medallion beneath a mouth rim with a band of wispy clouds, the exterior with three shaped panels one enclosing a phoenix and two a three-clawed dragon, all on a ground of classic lotus scroll, a further band of lotus scroll above the foot with double-bow string, the base with a three-legged toad maker's mark, wood stand. 19.5cm (7 3/4in) diam. (2).

artwork_title: Qianlong seal mark and of the period
description_block: Qianlong seal mark and of the period Elegantly potted of ogee form and painted around the exterior in rich cobalt-blue with two five-clawed dragons striding in mutual pursuit of the flaming pearl amongst wispy cloud, the interior with a single five-clawed dragon medallion. 16.9cm (6 5/8in) diam.

artwork_title: A RARE DOUCAI 'ANBAXIAN' OGEE BOWL
description_block: Qianlong seal mark and of the period Finely potted with wide flaring sides rising from a straight foot, exquisitely decorated to the centre in bright enamels with a flowerhead encircled by a border of interlocking lime-green foliate scrolls alternately suspending stylised peaches and lotus flowers, the cavetto with evenly spaced 'Eight Daoist Emblems' ( anbaxian ) each tied to flower sprays and fluttering ribbons between underglaze-blue double-line borders, the reverse richly enamelled with composite flower scrolls issuing exotic buds and blossoms, a band of upright ruyi heads encircling the foot. 20cm (7 7/8in) high.

artwork_title: Kangxi
description_block: Kangxi Thickly potted with flaring sides rising from a short, inward-tapering foot, finely decorated in the well with two geese swimming in a watery expanse beneath overhanging craggy rocks issuing large chrysanthemum flowers, one picked out in gilt, all within a border of butterflies and flowers set with fruit-shaped panels enclosing fish, shrimp and shells, the base with underglaze-blue leaf-shaped studio mark. 35cm (13 3/4in) diam.

artwork_title: A MING-STYLE BLUE AND WHITE 'LOTUS BOUQUET' MOONFLASK, BAOYUEHU
description_block: 18th century The flattened spherical body rising from a rectangular foot rim to a waisted neck and small bulb-shaped head, flanked with two elegantly arched strap handles ended with a ruyi -head terminal resting on the shoulder, freely painted in deep tones of cobalt accented with 'heaping and piling', the domed circular front and back depicting a mixed bouquet of lotus and other other water plants, the neck and head with a branch of flowers on both sides, the handles outlined with double lines extending to the ruyi terminus, above two branches of lotus running down the narrow sides, all covered with a glossy glaze of smooth texture, the foot rim unglazed, stand. 26cm (10 1/4in) high. (2).

artwork_title: A RARE FAMILLE VERTE AND BLACK ENAMEL 'DRAGONS' SAUCER-DISH
description_block: Yongzheng six-character mark and possibly of the period The enamels possibly later, finely potted with deep rounded sides rising from a short inward-tapering foot, decorated in the interior with a central medallion containing a writhing scaly five-clawed dragon in pursuit of the flaming pearl, the exterior with two striding dragons amidst flame wisps, all against a lustrous black-enamelled ground. 15cm (5 3/4in) diam.

artwork_title: Kangxi
description_block: Kangxi Sturdily potted with the lower globular body exquisitely decorated around the exterior with Emperor Sui Yangdi's dragon barge being pulled by a troupe of elegant ladies along the Grand Canal, the large barge replete with female musicians below, above, the Emperor receives a vase of flowers proffered by an elegant lady, at the head of the dragon barge, a boy performs a hand-stand, several other boats with musicians and courtiers accompany the larger barge while onlookers gaze in wonder, the upper section decorated with a scene of elegant ladies, children and gentlemen all within palatial garden settings with pavilions and trees, the domed cover surmounted by a lotus-bud finial. 81.5cm (32 1/8in) high. (2).

artwork_title: Kangxi
description_block: Kangxi The baluster form body below a trumpet neck carved in low relief with large rocks in celadon green, breaking up a watery landscape filled with pagodas and pine trees interspersed with wispy clouds with details picked out in copper red and rich cobalt blue. 70.8cm (28in) high.

artwork_title: Kangxi

description_block: Kangxi Robustly potted with a tall slightly tapering body rising to high shoulders and tall cylindrical neck with galleried rim, covered in a rich raspberry-red glaze applied evenly over the body and pooling at the foot, thinning to mushroom-grey at the mouth rim, the interior with apple-green tone glaze, the base covered in a creamy-mushroom glaze suffused with craquelure. 76.5cm (30 1/8in) high.

Each 18.4cm (7 1/4in) diam. (2).

artwork_title: Kangxi

artwork_title: A Huanghuali Rectangular Corner-Leg Low Table
description_block: Qing Dynasty The rectangular panelled top set within a wide border above a recessed waist and a plain apron, supported on four legs of square section terminating in hoof-feet and joined with four humpback stretchers. 93.5cm (36 3/4in) wide x 51.5cm (20in) high x 46.5cm (18 1/4in) deep.

artwork_title: A Huanghuali Yokeback Armchair, Nanguanmaoyi
description_block: Qing Dynasty The chair with a curved crest rail supported on curved rear posts and a s-shaped splat, the arm rails supported on slender, tapering standing stiles terminating in the front posts above the soft-mat seat supported by a board, all above a plain apron of square section and raised on legs of square section joined by straight stretchers and a plain footrest. 113.5cm (44 5/8in) high x 44cm (17 3/8in) deep x 58cm (22 7/8in) wide.

artwork_title: Qing Dynasty
description_block: Qing Dynasty With elegantly rounded protruding top with 'ice-plate' edge set on subtly splayed oval corner posts housing well-figured single panelled doors opening from the removable central stile to reveal the interior fitted with two shelves, with a metal three-part rectangular lock plate and pulls, all above a rectangular panel and a plain narrow apron with rounded apron spandrels. 107cm (42in) high x 74.5cm (29 1/4in) wide x 44cm (17 3/8in) deep.

artwork_title: The Banquet of Guo Ziyi
material: Ink, colour and gilt on paper
description_block: The Banquet of Guo Ziyi, 18th/19th century Ink, colour and gilt on paper, framed. 94cm (37in) high x 152cm (59 7/8in) wide.

artwork_title: Qing Dynasty
description_block: Qing Dynasty The shaft set with a single flower head alternating with almond-shaped petals with stippled swirls and filigree petals, with the stamen emerging from the centre. 11.7cm (4 5/8in) long; weight: 11gr.

artwork_title: Zhou Dynasty and later
description_block: Zhou Dynasty and later Comprising seven spade coins, bubi , each of a thin blade with square shoulders, bifurcated feet, and inscriptions to both sides, the largest approx.9.5cm (3 3/4in) long; together with fifteen round coins with square central holes, each cast with inscriptions to both sides, the largest approximately 6cm (2 3/8in) diam. (22).

artwork_title: Dragon and Lotus Tripod Incense Burner, Ding
description_block: Longqing 3rd year, corresponding to 1569 and of the period The body boldly carved in high relief with a pair of dragons pursuing the flaming pearl of wisdom, crouched over a large foliate lotus flower, the reverse with open blossoms on foliate ground, raised on three legs formed as mythical beast heads, all below the beaded galleried rim inscribed Longqing san nian run liu yue ji ri zao, si gua yi Xuan Di miao xianglu , flanked by a pair of curved handles, covered predominantly in thick green and ochre glaze. 44.7cm (17 5/8in) high.

artwork_title: Ming Dynasty
description_block: Ming Dynasty The thinly potted bowl of curving conical form with deep tapering sides rising from a short, slightly inward-tapering foot to a metal mouth rim, the interior carved with floral sprays, covered in an ivory-cream glaze suffused with crackles, fitted box. 15.8cm (6 1/4in) diam. (2).

artwork_title: Qing Dynasty
description_block: Qing Dynasty The quatrefoil body rising from a high foot, with four curved panels variously decorated with peony, lotus, chrysanthemum, and prunus between a band of lappets at the foot and key-fret below the rim, through the orange-red sulphide mineral, the bowl with pewter lining. 30.3cm (11 7/8in) diam.

artwork_title: Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove brushpot
description_block: Daoguang seal mark, 20th century Of cylindrical form, intricately carved around the exterior in various levels of relief with a continuous scene of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove engaged in scholarly pursuits including: playing weiqi , appreciating paintings, and playing the zither, accompanied by attendant boys, amidst a landscape with pine trees, bamboo, and mountains, the mouth rim encircled with an inscription in running script. 17cm (6 5/8in) high.
